header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) reports, "When Safiyya bint Huyay bin Akhtab (RA) entered Rasulullaah ﷺ's tent (as his wife), many people including myself presented ourselves there to have a share (of the Waleemah food). When he emerged from the tent, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Leave your mother (my wife) alone' (they all therefore left). When we gathered at the time of Isha, Rasulullaah ﷺ came out to us carrying in the edge of his shawl close to one and a half Mudd [^2] of Ajwah dates. (Handing them over to us) Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Eat from the Waleemah of your mother.' [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that because there were bluish marks around the eyes of Hadhrat Safiyya bint Huyay (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ asked her the reason for it. She replied, "When I told my husband that in a dream I had seen the moon falling in my lap, he slapped me saying, 'Do you desire the king of Yathrib (Madinah)?'"

Hadhrat Safiyya bint Huyay (RA) narrates, "There was no one more loathsome in my eyes than Rasulullaah ﷺ who had killed both my father and husband. However, this feeling disappeared from my heart when Rasulullaah ﷺ repeatedly clarified his position to me by telling me that my father had been responsible for instigating the Arabs against him and for numerous other felonies." [^4]

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ entered (his tent) with Hadhrat Safiyya (RA), Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) spent the night guarding the entrance. When he saw Rasulullaah ﷺ the next morning, he was (still) carrying his sword and exclaimed, "Allaahu Akbar! O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Because she was only recently married and you had her father, brother and husband killed, I did not trust her with you (It is for this reason that I have stood guard here all night)." Rasulullaah ﷺ laughed and praised Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA). [^5] Another narration states that Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) added, "Had she made any movement (to harm you), I would have been close by (to defend you)." [^6]

Hadhrat Ataa bin Yasaar narrates that when Hadhrat Safiyya bint Huyay (RA) arrived in Madinah, she stayed in a house belonging to Hadhrat Haaritha bin Nu'maan (RA). When the women of the Ansaar heard about her, they came to see her celebrated beauty.
